faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.prompt: Need help deciding which LED display solution is right for you? Speak to our team for expert advice and a tailored quote.

items.question: What LED screen hire services do you offer in London?
items.answer: We provide indoor and outdoor LED screen hire, TV hire, projector hire, video wall hire, digital signage, and complete AV equipment rental for corporate events, exhibitions, conferences, weddings, and live events across London.

items.question: Do you sell LED screens directly?
items.answer: Yes. We sell LED screens directly to businesses, retailers, property developers and venues across the UK. We can supply indoor and outdoor LED panels in a wide range of sizes and specifications, and optionally handle installation and commissioning. Contact us for a sales quote.

items.question: Can you permanently install an LED screen in our premises?
items.answer: Yes. We survey, design, supply and permanently install LED displays in retail shops, corporate offices, reception areas, hotels, restaurants, gyms, showrooms, healthcare premises and commercial properties across London and the UK. We also provide ongoing maintenance and technical support.

items.question: Do you offer long-term LED screen rental contracts?
items.answer: Yes. We offer long-term LED screen rental contracts on 12, 24 and 36-month terms for commercial customers. This includes delivery, installation, maintenance and technical support, so there is no large capital outlay. Long-term rental is ideal for retailers, gyms, bars, restaurants, offices and healthcare premises. Contact us to discuss your requirements.

items.question: What commercial premises do you work with?
items.answer: We work with a wide range of commercial customers including retail shops, corporate offices, reception areas, hotels, restaurants, bars, gyms, showrooms, healthcare premises, GP surgeries, property developers and commercial landlords. Whether you need a screen purchased, rented long-term or permanently installed, we can help.

items.question: Do you provide setup and technical support?
items.answer: Yes. Our experienced team handles delivery, installation, testing, on-site technical support, and dismantling to ensure your event runs smoothly. For permanent installations and long-term rentals, we also provide ongoing maintenance and aftercare.

items.question: Can I hire LED screens for a one-day event?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer flexible rental options for one-day events, weekends, and long-term hire based on your requirements.

items.question: What size LED screens do you offer?
items.answer: We offer a wide range of LED screen sizes suitable for indoor and outdoor events, permanent installations and commercial use, from small presentations to large-scale concerts, exhibitions and digital advertising displays.

items.question: How much does LED screen hire cost in London?
items.answer: Pricing depends on screen size, rental duration, event location, and technical requirements. Contact us for a free, no-obligation quote tailored to your requirement.

items.question: Do you cover events and projects outside London?
items.answer: Yes. We support events and commercial projects across the UK and worldwide. Include your project location in your enquiry and we will discuss equipment, transport, installation and support for your venue or premises.

items.question: How do I choose the right LED display solution?
items.answer: Start by telling us what you need the screen for — a one-off event, a permanent installation in your business premises, a long-term commercial rental or a direct purchase. Our team will advise on the right screen type, size and delivery model for your situation.
